subsystems.name: Sensing layer
subsystems.role: picks up what is happening in a space without being asked.

subsystems.name: Always-on edge compute
subsystems.role: does the first, cheapest pass of interpretation locally so nothing has to be streamed.

subsystems.name: Connectivity fabric
subsystems.role: lets devices find each other and hand context between rooms and devices.

subsystems.name: Multimodal models
subsystems.role: turn raw signals into intent — speech, gesture, gaze, presence.
parts: language model for reasoning about requests

subsystems.name: Context and arbitration engine
subsystems.role: decides who is present, what they probably want, and which device should respond.

subsystems.name: Output and actuation
subsystems.role: answers in whatever channel is least intrusive — sometimes no screen at all.

subsystems.name: Privacy and data governance
subsystems.role: keeps continuous sensing acceptable to the people living with it.
parts: on-device processing to avoid uploading raw audio or video

buildSteps.title: Decide the context to support
buildSteps.detail: Pick a bounded behaviour — hands-free control of lights and media, or a wearable that answers when glanced at — rather than 'everything, everywhere'.

buildSteps.title: Instrument the space or body
buildSteps.detail: Mount microphones, radar and sensors where they have power and a clean line of sight, and design for always-on operation at milliwatts so batteries last weeks.

buildSteps.title: Build the low-power trigger stage
buildSteps.detail: A tiny always-listening or always-watching circuit detects a wake word, a person entering, or a gesture, and only then powers up the heavy processor.

buildSteps.title: Fit models onto the device
buildSteps.detail: Speech, vision and fusion models are quantised and pruned so they run within the processor's memory and thermal budget, with latency under a few hundred milliseconds.

buildSteps.title: Establish the device fabric
buildSteps.detail: Bring devices onto a shared mesh (for example Thread or Matter) with a local hub, so a request in one room can act on hardware made by another vendor.

buildSteps.title: Build the context model
buildSteps.detail: Fuse presence, identity, time, location and recent activity into a state estimate, then define which device should answer and how confident that estimate must be before acting.

buildSteps.title: Handle heavy reasoning off-device
buildSteps.detail: Route requests that exceed local compute to a cloud or home server, with clear rules about what data leaves the device.

buildSteps.title: Design the privacy architecture
buildSteps.detail: Minimise raw data movement, process audio and video locally, add hardware mute and visible indicators, and encrypt anything that is stored.

buildSteps.title: Tune behaviour in real homes
buildSteps.detail: The hard part is not accuracy but appropriateness — silence, escalation, graceful failure and the ability to correct a wrong guess in one step.

prerequisites.why: always-on sensing has to cost microwatts to milliwatts if it is to be built into rooms and wearables.
running speech and vision locally is what keeps latency low and raw data off the network.
models that combine speech, vision and language exist, but shrinking them onto low-power hardware is still limited.
cross-vendor ecosystems only work if devices share addressing, discovery and control protocols.
acting on context without a command is only acceptable if the system almost never mistakes who is there.

pathway.milestone: voice assistants, smart speakers and phone-level sensor fusion respond to explicit commands and simple routines
pathway.unlocks: habits and hardware already in homes, but fragmented across vendors.

pathway.milestone: multimodal on-device assistants in earbuds, watches and glasses that use presence, gaze and gesture rather than wake words
pathway.unlocks: interaction that survives without a screen or a spoken command.

pathway.milestone: standardised interoperability so devices from different makers share context in one home
pathway.unlocks: a genuine ambient layer instead of isolated product silos.

pathway.milestone: continuously personalised assistance with local models and strong privacy guarantees
pathway.unlocks: computing that fades into the environment, as long as sensing remains trustworthy.
